response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the majestic castle walls, but something is off. The stone façade is still imposing, but the flags bearing the royal crest now flutter in a strange, dreamlike rhythm. The sound of distant, warped synthesizers drifts through the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN III sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the usual stern expressions, they all wear garish, neon-colored wigs and sunglasses.

KING ARIN III
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our empire. One that is... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futuristic.

ADVISOR 1
(nervously)
Uh, sire, I think you mean "futuristic" as in, from the future?

KING ARIN III
(nodding)
Yes, yes, that's it. From the future. We must incorporate more... (he gestures to a nearby servant, who is holding a tray of strange, glowing orbs)...glow.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, sire. These are the latest in imperial technology. They will... (he consults a small, leather-bound book)...project a holographic image of the empire's history.

KING ARIN III
(impressed)
Ah, excellent. We will display this hologram in the great hall, surrounded by... (he looks around the room)...more of these... (he points to a nearby tapestry, which is now displaying a psychedelic, swirling pattern)...swirls.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The camera pans over the castle grounds, where workers are busy constructing a series of bizarre, futuristic-looking structures. There are towering, crystalline spires, and strange, glowing orbs that seem to pulse with an otherworldly energy.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Arin III stands before his advisors, a look of excitement on his face.

KING ARIN III
(my friends, we are on the cusp of a new era. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...vaporwave.

ADVISOR 2
(confused)
Vaporwave, sire?

KING ARIN III
(nodding)
Yes, yes. It's a style. A style of... (he gestures to a nearby servant, who is holding a small, cassette tape)...music.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, sire. This is a rare, vintage cassette tape. It's said to contain the sounds of... (he consults the tape)...the future.

KING ARIN III
(impressed)
Ah, excellent. We will play this tape in the great hall, surrounded by... (he looks around the room)...more of these... (he points to a nearby, fog machine)...fogs.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The camera pans over the castle grounds, where the workers are now busy constructing a series of bizarre, futuristic-looking sculptures. There are towering, crystalline spires, and strange, glowing orbs that seem to pulse with an otherworldly energy.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Arin III sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. The room is filled with the sound of warped synthesizers and distant, foggy whispers.

KING ARIN III
(to his advisors)
We are the rulers of a new era. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.
